sections.title: The Only Full-Spectrum Community Makerspace in Kalamazoo
sections.intro: Unlike university or library makerspaces, Kzoo Makers is a public, nonprofit workshop offering full access to woodworking, metalworking, CNC, laser cutting, and fabrication tools for real projects—not just demonstrations or coursework.

sections.title: What Makes Kzoo Makers Different
sections.intro: We're the only place in Kalamazoo where the general public can access professional-grade fabrication equipment with hands-on control, flexible hours, and a community of makers ready to help you succeed.

sections.title: Why Serious Makers Choose Kzoo Makers

items.heading: Complete Fabrication Capability
items.text: The only place locally with wood + metal + CNC + laser under one roof. Build anything from furniture to metal sculpture to product prototypes.

items.heading: Hands-On Tool Access
items.text: After safety training, you operate the equipment yourself. No staff-mediated projects or waiting for someone else to run your job.

items.heading: Flexible Hours
items.text: Open evenings and weekends. Trained members get 56 hours of access. Work on your schedule, not ours.

items.heading: Commercial Use Supported
items.text: Start your business, prototype products, or run small production. We explicitly support entrepreneurial projects.

items.heading: Peer Mentorship
items.text: Learn from experienced makers in a collaborative environment. Real skill transfer, not just demonstrations.

items.heading: Open to Everyone
items.text: No enrollment required. No coursework. No academic affiliation. Just a passion for making.

items.heading: 🪵 Wood Shop
items.text:
- Table saw, jointer, planer
- Band saws, drill press
- Router table, sanders
- Hand tools and clamps
- Dust collection system

**Build:** Furniture, cabinets, art, home projects

items.heading: ⚙️ Metal Shop
items.text:
- MIG and TIG welding
- Metal lathe and mill
- Angle grinders, cut-off saw
- Drill press, band saw
- Fabrication tables

**Build:** Steel sculpture, brackets, frames, repairs

items.heading: ✨ Laser Cutting
items.text:
- Industrial 100W CO2 laser
- 24" x 36" cutting bed
- Cut and engrave wood, acrylic, leather
- Precision up to 0.001"
- Production runs supported

**Build:** Signs, art, product prototypes, gifts

items.heading: 🤖 CNC Router
items.text:
- Full-size CNC router
- 4' x 8' capable cutting area
- Cut wood, plastic, soft metals
- 3D carving and engraving
- Large-format projects

**Build:** Furniture parts, signs, molds, templates

items.heading: 🖨️ 3D Printing
items.text:
- Multiple FDM printers
- Various build volumes
- Hands-on operation
- Member-owned printers welcome
- Filament available

**Build:** Prototypes, parts, tools, art

items.heading: ⚡ Electronics Lab
items.text:
- Soldering stations
- Oscilloscopes and multimeters
- Power supplies
- Component storage
- Arduino and Raspberry Pi support

**Build:** Circuits, robots, IoT devices, repairs

sections.title: What You Can't Get at Other Makerspaces

items.heading: Capabilities Unique to Kzoo Makers in Kalamazoo:
items.text:
- Public access to a full wood shop
- Public access to metal fabrication and welding
- Industrial laser cutting for the public
- Full-size CNC routing for the public
- Hands-on tool operation (not staff-mediated)
- 56 hour access for trained members

- Commercial and entrepreneurial use
- Heavy fabrication and noisy work
- Long-term project storage
- Peer-to-peer skill sharing
- No enrollment or coursework required
- Ongoing access (not semester-bound)

items.heading: Furniture & Woodworking
items.text: Members build custom tables, cabinets, cutting boards, picture frames, and home renovations using our complete wood shop.

items.heading: Metal Fabrication
items.text: Welded sculptures, steel furniture, bike racks, automotive repairs, custom brackets, and metal art projects.

items.heading: Product Prototyping
items.text: Entrepreneurs develop product prototypes, test designs, and run small production batches for their businesses.

items.heading: Laser Engraving
items.text: Custom signs, wedding gifts, business products, leather goods, acrylic displays, and personalized items.

items.heading: Electronics Projects
items.text: Arduino robots, home automation, circuit repairs, custom PCBs, and IoT devices.

items.heading: Art & Sculpture
items.text: Mixed-media art, metal sculpture, wood carving, installations, and creative experiments.

items.heading: Peer Mentorship
items.text: Learn from experienced makers who are passionate about sharing skills. No formal classes—just makers helping makers.

items.heading: Volunteer-Run
items.text: Every member contributes to keeping the space running. This isn't a service—it's a community you're part of.

items.heading: Collaborative Environment
items.text: Work alongside people from all backgrounds: engineers, artists, entrepreneurs, hobbyists, students, and retirees.

items.heading: Events & Meetups
items.text: Regular meetups, skill shares, and social events. Connect with other makers and learn new techniques.

items.label: Starting at per month
items.text: Affordable tiers for every budget and usage level

items.heading: 56 hour/wk
items.label: Access for trained members
items.text: Work on your schedule, not limited to business hours

items.label: Ongoing access
items.text: Not semester-bound or time-limited

items.heading: ✅ You Should Join If:
items.text:
- You need wood or metal fabrication tools
- You want to learn welding, CNC, or laser cutting
- You're starting a business or prototyping products
- You want hands-on control of professional tools
- You need flexible hours (evenings/weekends)
- You value community and peer learning
- You're serious about making things

items.heading: ❓ Consider Alternatives If:
items.text:
- **You're a WMU/KVCC student:** Use university resources for coursework, but join us for tools they don't have
- **You only need light crafting:** Library makerspaces might be sufficient (and free)
- **You want staff to do the work:** We're hands-on—you operate the tools
- **You're just curious:** Schedule a free tour first to see if it's right for you

sections.title: The Bottom Line
sections.intro: If you're serious about making—whether it's furniture, metal art, product prototypes, or just learning new skills—Kzoo Makers is the only place in Kalamazoo that gives you:

items.heading: Full-Spectrum Tools
items.text: Wood, metal, laser, CNC, electronics, and more

items.heading: Hands-On Access
items.text: You control the tools after training

items.heading: Public Access
items.text: No enrollment or affiliation required

sections.outro: **We're not just a makerspace. We're a community of makers building real things.**
